summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch view, coordinate array) pairs, with coordinates computed as start/stop minus padding offset; set_rnd skips names starting with "__"); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates, with NumPy ceiling worker split, apply_transform with map_items=False, and a NotImplementedError when len() is missing; PatchDataset docstring uses float); monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst has a PatchIter autodoc entry; tests/test_grid_dataset.py adds TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array, and an extra test_missing_length. Nothing was run: no tests, no scripts, no installs, per instructions. The pinned values in test_loading_array and the docstring example output are unverified. Lines 231-233 of utils.py exceed 120 characters in a pre-existing docstring that was not touched. No commits were made.
